periods.time: Ouma's raid on the Tatra US base
periods.summary: Ouma breaks into the US base, draws fire away from Charlotte, and fights Abraham Carter. He learns Abraham was the hidden opponent who once defeated him, overcomes the old trauma, but is briefly caught by Hypnotism and badly beaten. After seeing Rinna and Sara's torture room, Ouma abandons his self-imposed restriction, absorbs the surrounding wind, completes Danzuki Tenryuusou: Shinuchi, and kills one Abraham with Ippatsu no Kaze. Arlanz then reveals PSYON is an army of Abraham clones, and their combined psychokinesis pins Ouma until Nango intervenes.
periods.cause: Charlotte's report leads Ouma to the base where Kazamatsuri's group is imprisoned.
periods.process: Ouma destroys walls, soldiers and tanks with wind abilities. Abraham appears and uses teleportation, precognition, psychokinesis, electrokinesis and hypnosis. Ouma initially rejoices at facing the source of his fear, but the torture victims make the battle a war rather than a pure challenge. He devours ambient wind, compresses an enormous storm sword and cuts through even Abraham's attempted teleport destination. When he threatens Arlanz, dozens of identical Abrahams reveal themselves and overwhelm him with numbers.
periods.outcome: One Abraham clone is killed, but Ouma cannot defeat the massed PSYON clones alone. Nango arrives just before a lethal combined pyrokinetic attack lands.
periods.significance: Pays off Ouma's old Tyrant trauma, introduces Abraham as a clone army, and exposes the scale of Arlanz's military biotechnology.
